the diffusion of mobile service is affected by both internal and external influences.

the diffusion of mobile services.
the development of a new method for the analysis of the diffusion of innovations.
the diffusion of mobile services in the context of mobile music services.

the diffusion of mobile phone music services is affected by a combination of external influences, internal influences, and the Von Bertalanffly model.
the diffusion of mobile service adoption in Taiwan was mainly driven by internal influences, and that external influences had a limited impact on the diffusion of mobile services.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed an empirical model for the diffusion of mobile phone music service adoption in Taiwan and that our results indicate that the diffusion process of the adoption of mobile phone music services is best characterized as a mixed diffusion process.

we have shown how to use the diffusion of innovations theory to explain and predict the diffusion of a specific type of mobile music service, and have identified the most effective influence sources to promote mobile music diffusion.
we have shown that the diffusion of mobile services is affected by both external and internal influences.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, in addition to the usual suspects (i.e., the external and internal influences) that are often considered when examining the diffusion of innovations, there is a new influence, namely, the service provider, which is a critical factor that should be considered when examining the mobile music service adoption.

the diffusion model is an important and useful tool for the analysis of diffusion processes, especially when it comes to understanding how the diffusion process is affected by the presence of a diffusion barrier.
the diffusion of a new technology is affected by both external and internal influences, and that the relative influence of these two types of factors depends on the nature of the technology.
